title: AFL.------VT.DY.
description: Second diagram on page 392 (JR-14). The crossing diagrams how affinity-alignment structurally meets vibrational-dynamics: AFL crossed with VT-DY. AFL sits at left with the subject-arrow; VT-DY at center-right as partner-axis. MT-INFO (meta-information) upper-center, INFO-DY (information dynamics) upper-right, INVT-DT (invitation-dictates) right. TM (matrix), IST-F (isolated focus) right. CULT-AF-BS (cultural-affinity base) lower-left, C-CONT (composite continuance) lower-left. TR (transformation) lower-left, IF-ST-DY (isolated-focus stable-dynamics) lower-center, PER-DY (perceived dynamics) lower-center. Structural argument: the upper chain MT-INFO -> INFO-DY -> INVT-DT routes the form's affinity-alignment through information-dynamics into invitation-dictates. The lower chain CULT-AF-BS -> C-CONT -> TR routes through composite-continuance. The central TM and IST-F hubs route the form into the partner's working chain.
